name: Quismondo (Spain)
description: A red hoist third and a yellow fly charged with three green poplars, the central one taller.
history: The arms of Quismondo were approved by the Junta de Comunidades de Castilla-La Mancha by decree published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 15 September 1987, following the opinion of the Real Academia de la Historia: per fess, or a poplar vert accompanied by two smaller ones, and gules four crosslets sable. The flag was granted by the Department of Public Administrations by order published in the DOCM of 24 April 2002: a flag of proportion 1:1.5, tierced at the hoist, gules the hoist third and or the remaining two thirds, with a poplar vert accompanied by two smaller ones centred on the or field in proportion 3:4.

features.role: three poplars, the central one taller
